title: New data show the object separated from the seabed

tellings.quote: It looks like it's separated from the bottom. That's what I can say.

plain: New survey data from 2025 show that the Baltic Sea anomaly, a strange round shape lying on the floor of the Baltic Sea, appears to be separated from the seabed beneath it. Dennis Asberg, the treasure hunter whose team found it, tells Michels this himself, adding only: "That's what I can say." If true, it would mean the object sits on the bottom rather than being part of the rock.
